title: The Lonely Island Is Back
subtitle: Andy Samberg's return to parody music is a welcome relief.
body_html:
The Frontier Psychiatrists is a daily Health theme newsletter. Today, I'm gonna remind you that I have three events coming up that you can attend!

I'm also going to write about the lonely island. Yes, I know this is a health-themed publication. I could come up with some sort of justification for why I want to write about the lonely island, other than the fact that I just can't get enough of how funny their content is recently, and I felt like sharing it. I almost wrote an article about Sushi Glory Hole , couldn't come up with a plausible angle. It’s really funny.

However, today, I couldn't stop it. I logged onto YouTube for something else entirely, and I'm presented with the following collaboration between the Lonely Island and Charlie XCX… it's just so good.

Getting satire just right is difficult. They stick the landing. That is all. I have no health spin on that. I just love it. I felt seen.

Share
